anyOf.description:
`fail_on` — the minimum severity at which findings fail the command:
`error` (the default), `warn` (warnings also fail), `never`
(report-only). Read here and carried; the CLI decides where it applies.

fail_on.description:
`error` | `warn` | `never` — the minimum severity at which findings
fail a run. `--fail-on` overrides it.

model_fanout_threshold.description:
Compat flat keys — the same value `rules.<id>.threshold` sets; both
spellings together are an error naming both keys.

source_fanout_threshold.description:
Compat flat key — the same value `rules.source_fanout.threshold`
sets; both spellings together are an error naming both keys.

naming_prefixes.description: layer dir → allowed prefixes; merges per-layer over the defaults.

baseline.description:
The frozen-violations file — resolved against this file's directory
in `ProjectConfig::load`.

oneOf.description:
Only the rules whose registry `default_severity` is `Error` — the
broken-guarantee and build-failure checks.

Every rule the registry enables by default (`default_enabled`) —
the set a run uses when no preset is configured.

Every rule, including the opt-in ones shipped with
`default_enabled: false`.

anyOf.description:
The rule set a run starts from — `.dbtl.yml`'s `lint.preset` and the
CLI's `--preset`. Presets only decide whether each unconfigured rule
runs; `lint.categories`, `lint.rules.<id>`, and `--rules` sit above them
(see `LintConfig::severity`), so a preset never overrides a setting the
project wrote explicitly.

preset.description: base lint rule set: `minimal` (error-default rules only), `standard` (the shipped default), `strict` (every rule, opt-in included). `lint.categories`, `lint.rules.<id>`, and `--rules` sit above it. Unknown names are an error.

categories.description: category → `error` | `warn` | `off` — one severity (and enable/disable) for a whole category at once. Above `lint.preset`, below `lint.rules.<id>`. Unknown category names are an error.

`check:` — gate severities/parameters and whether the lint gates
fold into `dbtl check`.

catalog.description:
`docs.catalog` — opt in to the sibling `catalog.json` (same path rule
as the CLI's auto-detect, but only when the file asks for it).

lineage_depth.description: Mermaid ancestry depth per node page: an integer ≥ 1, or `all` for the whole closure (default 2).

owner_meta_key.description:
The `meta:` key the affected-owners report reads (default `owner`;
wins over `config.yml`'s `owner_meta_key`).
